newsitem.title: SPAIN: Selected profit-taking takes Madrid stocks lower.
newsitem.headline: Selected profit-taking takes Madrid stocks lower.

text.p: Madrid stocks were a touch lower at midday on Friday, as selected profit-taking set in following various sessions of strong gains.
However falls may be limited amid strong advances in bonds and ahead of any concrete budget announcement.
The general index fell 0.38 points, 0.10 percent, to 367.38 and the Ibex shed 7.94 points, 0.19 percent, to 4,205.98.
Most losses were seen in banks and utilities, in particular those having outperformed recently such as BBV, down 70 pesetas to 5,870, and Santander, off 20 pesetas to 6,640.
